decisions.reason: As a core bread item close to the bakery's traditional everyday offer, it likely remains unless the assortment is slightly streamlined.
A sweet pastry fits the firm's confectionery identity well, though pastries are somewhat more replaceable within a medium-sized range than staple breads.
This farmhouse bread matches the firm's craft, regional and traditional positioning, but it faces some overlap risk with other bread loaves in the assortment.
As a flagship seasonal product with its own page and a gold-award result, this stollen is strongly aligned with the firm's direction and brand strength.
The premium Christmas stollen is award-winning and well suited to the firm's festive specialty business, though it has slightly more overlap risk than the flagship poppy-seed version.
